title: Saudi prince buys 5% stake in Lucid Motors | TechCrunch
summary: Prince Al Waleed bin Talal Al Saud, a member of the Saudi royal family, has purchased a 5% stake in Lucid Motors, increasing the Kingdom’s overall ownership of the electric vehicle company.
